open_items: Lead list's $75M funds from 2013, 2016 and 2019 not confirmed; only the fifth fund ($75M, announced 2025-06-10 via a podcast interview) was fetched. Fund V name/number comes from the article ('fifth fund'), not the firm.
Check size not stated on fetched pages. Stages recorded as seed only from 'seed fund'; the homepage says 'early stages'. Opportunity fund ($75M) invests later in existing portfolio companies.
HQ: the Manual lists both San Francisco and New York offices; San Francisco listed first. No application URL found; Manual says to reach out to team members individually.

Round dates are article dates at month precision (Vals AI: Pulse 2.0 dated Aug 15 2026, Sacra search result said Aug 13). A claimed Humans& seed participation was not confirmed (Crunchbase News article does not name Bloomberg Beta); Caplight Series A not confirmed either.
Company websites and HQs not on the fetched pages; left null.
